sql: SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status;
SELECT id, status, title FROM article WHERE status = 'c_11' OR status = 'c_23';
SELECT article, kind, text FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7];
SELECT id, article, kind, text FROM brief WHERE text CONTAINS 'kill' OR text CONTAINS 'pull' OR text CONTAINS 'retract';
SELECT id, heading, body FROM factbox WHERE body CONTAINS 'kill' OR body CONTAINS 'pull' OR heading CONTAINS 'kill' OR heading CONTAINS 'pull';
SELECT id, status, published_at, desk FROM article WHERE status != 'c_04' ORDER BY status;
SELECT id, status, (SELECT VALUE out FROM covers WHERE in = $parent.id) AS topics, (SELECT VALUE id FROM passage WHERE parent = $parent.id) AS passages FROM article WHERE status != 'c_04';
